62701.meaning1: name of a layman; Visākha's grandson
62701.commentary: (VINa) sāḷho'ti tassa nāmaṃ, migāramātuyā pana nattā hoti, tena vuttaṃ migāranattā'ti

examples.text: atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā sāṇo ca sekhuniyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ. atha kho sāḷho ca licchavi abhayo ca licchavi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

62705.meaning1: (gram) verbal ending of the present tense 2nd person singular

examples.text: asass'eva dhātussa simhi vibhattimhi antassa lopo ca hoti. ko nu tvam'asi mārisa.

62706.grammar: pr 2nd sg of atthi, abbrev of asi, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, saṅkhārānaṃ khayaṃ ñatvā, akataññū'si brāhmaṇa.
uṭṭhehi, āvuso, diṭṭho'si bhagavatā, n'atthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso'ti
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ suvaṇṇasikat'āvasissanti.

62709.meaning1: basket or net of a carrying pole

62710.commentary: (VINa) paññattaṃ pana sikkhāpadaṃ sabbehi'pi lajjīpuggalehi samaṃ sikkhitabbabhāvato samasikkhatā nāma

examples.text: asaṃvāso'ti saṃvāso nāma ekakammaṃ ek'uddeso samasikkhatā, eso saṃvāso nāma. so tena saddhiṃ n'atthi. tena vuccati, asaṃvāso'ti.
etha tumhe, āvuso, sīlavā hotha, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesū'ti
methunam'anuyuttassa, vighātaṃ brūhi mārisa, sutvāna tava sāsanaṃ, viveke sikkhissāmase.

62712.meaning1: trains (in); trains (for the purpose of); practices (for the sake of); practice (to)

examples.text: paññaṃ nappamajjeyya, saccam'anurakkheyya, cāgam'anubrūheyya, santim'eva so sikkheyyā'ti, ayam'uddeso dhātuvibhaṅgassa.
uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, daḷhaṃ sikkhatha santiyā, mā vo pamatte viññāya, maccurājā amohayittha vas'ānuge.
atha kho, bho, te cha khattiyā ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, ime kho brāhmaṇā nāma itthiluddhā, yaṃnūna mayaṃ mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ itthīhi sikkheyyāmā'ti.

ta'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti pāsādikasutte sikkhattayasaṅgahitaṃ sakalasāsanaṃ brahmacariyan'ti vuttaṃ. imasmim'pi ṭhāne idam'eva brahmacariyan'ti adhippetaṃ.

pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāyā'ti pesalānaṃ piyasīlānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihāratthāya. piyasīlā hi bhikkhū kattabb'ākattabbaṃ sāvajj'ānavajjaṃ velaṃ mariyādaṃ ajānantā sikkhattayapāripūriyā ghaṭamānā kilamanti, sandiṭṭhamānā ubbāḷhā honti.

62715.meaning1: holy life with its three trainings

62717.meaning1: in reference to AN3.87 Paṭhamasikkhāsutta, AN3.88 Dutiyasikkhāsutta and AN3.89 Tatiyasikkhāsutta

examples.text: samaṇo gadrabho khettaṃ, vajjiputto ca sekkhakaṃ, tayo ca sikkhanā vuttā, dve sikkhā saṅkavāya cā'ti.
svākkhātaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, sandiṭṭhikam'akālikaṃ, yattha amoghā pabbajjā, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.
sekhassa sikkhamānassa, ujumagg'ānusārino, khayasmiṃ paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tato aññā anantarā.

62722.meaning2: female novice undergoing a probationary course
62722.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.9) sikkhamānā nāma dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
paribbājikā nāma bhikkhuniñ'ca sikkhamānañ'ca sāmaṇeriñ'ca ṭhapetvā yā kāci paribbājikasamāpannā.

62725.grammar: imp, reflx 2rd sg of sikkhati, intrans (+loc)
62725.meaning1: you yourself must train yourself (in); you yourself should practice
62725.meaning2: you must train yourself; let you study by yourself
62725.commentary: (THIa) sikkhassu sikkhāyā'ti adhisīlasikkh'ādikāya tividhāya sikkhāya sikkha, maggasampayuttā tisso sikkhāyo sampādehī'ti attho.

examples.text: iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū'ti

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

62728.commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sikkhā'ti tisso sikkhā, adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā. tatra y'āyaṃ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā sikkhā'ti.

examples.text: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto.
kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.

62729.commentary: (SNa) sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti tividhā'pi sikkhā kātabbā. yog'ādīsu yogo'ti payogo. chando'ti kattu'kamyatākusalacchando. ussoḷhī'ti sabbasahaṃ adhimattavīriyaṃ.

examples.text: sv'āhaṃ idha pañca sikkhā karitvā, paṭipajjitvā tathāgatassa dhamme, dvepatham'agamāsiṃ coramajjhe, te maṃ tattha vadhiṃsu bhogahetu.
parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

62730.meaning1: a precept to be observed; a training rule to be practised
62730.commentary: (SNa) sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti tividhā'pi sikkhā kātabbā. yog'ādīsu yogo'ti payogo. chando'ti kattu'kamyatākusalacchando. ussoḷhī'ti sabbasahaṃ adhimattavīriyaṃ.

examples.text: na bhuñjamāno sabbaṃ hatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmī'ti sikkhākaraṇīyā'ti.

62731.meaning1: desiring to train; wanting to practice

examples.text: tama't'agge mete, ānanda, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā'ti
ye te bhikkhū app'icchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissatī'ti!

62734.meaning1: respectful towards the training; giving weight to the practice

examples.text: ye c'aññe bhikkhū sikkhāgāravā tesañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena. attanā ca sikkhāgāravo hoti, sikkhāgāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī.

62735.meaning1: fact of having respect for the training; fact of giving weight to the practice

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

62738.meaning1: weakness with regard to the training; lack of capability to practice

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu raj'aggaññ'eva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.

62739.meaning1: suffered from weakness with regard to the training; kept the training rules badly

examples.text: yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅ'kato, so bhagavatā byākato, sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti. saraṇāni sakko sikkhādubbalyam'āpādi, majjapānaṃ apāyī'ti.

62741.meaning1: benefit of training; profit of practice; (comm) training is the benefit

62742.meaningLit: discourse on the benefits of training

62744.meaning1: excellency of training; best kind of practice
62744.commentary: (DNa) hatthisipp'ādi-sikkhanaṃ na sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkhattayapūraṇaṃ pana sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: cha anuttariyāni, dassan'ānuttariyaṃ, savan'ānuttariyaṃ, lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.

62746.commentary: (ANa) sikkhati sikkhāpadesū'ti taṃ taṃ sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyitvā sikkhati. apica samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesū'ti yaṃkiñci sikkhāpadesu sikkhākoṭṭhāsesu sikkhitabbaṃ kāyikaṃ vā vācasikaṃ vā, taṃ sabbaṃ sammā ādāya sikkhati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudd'ānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.

62747.meaning1: counting the precepts; enumerating the training rules

62748.meaning1: concerned with training rules; related to precepts
62748.commentary: (ANa) sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāyā'ti sikkhāsaṅkhātehi padehi paṭisaṃyuttāya, tīhi sikkhāhi samannāgatāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

62750.meaning1: one hundred training rules; one hundred precepts
62750.commentary: (ANa) diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasatan'ti paṇṇās'ādhikaṃ sikkhāpadasataṃ. tasmiṃ samaye paññattāni sikkhāpadān'eva sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. so kira bhikkhu ajjavasampanno ujujātiko avaṅko akuṭilo, tasmā ahaṃ ettakāni sikkhāpadāni rakkhituṃ sakkuṇeyyaṃ vā na vā'ti cintetvā satthu ārocesi.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so vajjiputtako bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sādhikam'idaṃ, bhante, diyaḍḍhaṃ sikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. n'āhaṃ, bhante, ettha sakkomi sikkhitun'ti.

62753.meaning1: disparaging the training rules; speaking badly of the precepts
62753.commentary: (KVa) sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake'ti evaṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ vivaṇṇake garahaṇe pācittiyaṃ hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.

62757.commentary: (DNa) sippaṃ sikkhāpentī'ti attano ovāde ṭhitabhāvaṃ ñatvā vaṃs'ānugataṃ muddāgaṇan'ādi-sippaṃ sikkhāpenti.

examples.text: pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.
daharakālato paṭṭhāya hi naṃ mārāpento'va seṭṭhi māretuṃ n'āsakkhi, kiṃ akkharasamayaṃ sikkhāpessati?

62758.meaning2: to cause to train; to make learn

examples.text: sikkhāpentā'pi therehi, bālā cīvaradhāraṇaṃ, na suṇissanti dummedhā, pākaṭā kāmakāriyā.
tatr'idaṃ vatthu, eko kira naṭako suvapotakaṃ gahetvā sikkhāpento vicarati. so bhikkhun'upassayaṃ upanissāya vasitvā gamanakāle suvapotakaṃ pamussitvā gato. taṃ sāmaṇeriyo gahetvā paṭijaggiṃsu.

62760.commentary: (DNa) sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hotī'ti sikkhattayapūraṇe bahalacchando hoti. (DNt) sikkhāya samma'd'eva ādānaṃ sikkhāsamādānaṃ, taṃ pan'assā pāripūriyā veditabban'ti āha sikkhattayapūraṇe'ti. sikkhāya vā samma'd'eva ādito paṭṭhāya rakkhaṇaṃ sikkhāsamādānaṃ, tañ'ca atthato pūraṇe paricchinnaṃ arakkhaṇe sabbena sabbaṃ abhāvato, rakkhaṇe ca paripūraṇato.

examples.text: tassa na tādiso chando hoti adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ

62761.commentary: (VINa) sikkhāsammutiṃ dātun'ti kasmā dāpesi? mātugāmo nāma lolo hoti dve vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitvā sīlāni pūrayamāno kilamati, sikkhitvā pana pacchā na kilamissati, nittharissatī'ti dāpesi.

62762.meaning1: training and lifestyle; practice and precepts (of)
62762.commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.

62763.meaning1: undertaken the training and lifestyle; engaged in the practice and precepts (of)
62763.commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti. (ANa) sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno'ti yā bhikkhūnaṃ adhisīlasaṅkhātā sikkhā, tañ'ca, yattha c'ete saha jīvanti, ekajīvikā sabhāgavuttino honti, taṃ bhagavatā paññattasikkhāpadasaṅkhātaṃ sājīvañ'ca tattha sikkhanabhāvena samāpanno'ti bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno.

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

62765.meaningLit: group of eleven elided discourses starting with the discourse on training
62765.sanskrit: śikṣā + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + ādi + paryāya, peyāla (bsk) + ekādaśaka

62766.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
bāhusaccañ'ca sippañ'ca, vinayo ca susikkhito, subhāsitā ca yā vācā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

62769.meaning1: should be learned; should be practised; should be trained (by)
62769.meaning2: should be learnt, should be practised

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne'ti.

daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā't'iha vo, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.
sikkhitā kho pana hoti. kām'aññe bhikkhū sikkhantu vā mā vā, aham'ettha sikkhissāmī'ti cittaṃ uppādeti.
sikkhamānā nāma dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā.

62772.meaning1: fact of being one who trains (in); fact of being one who practises
62772.construction:
sikkhita + sikkhā + a + tā
sikkhitasikkha + tā

62773.meaning1: wanting to practise; wishing to train
62773.commentary: (VINa) sikkhitu'kāmo'ti yena paññattena vuccati, taṃ paññattaṃ na sikkhitu'kāmo.

examples.text: dhamm'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno kath'āyaṃ nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā antaradhāyeyya vā, taṃ vā na sikkhitu'kāmo anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

62774.commentary: (VINa) sikkhitu'kāmo'ti yena paññattena vuccati, taṃ paññattaṃ na sikkhitu'kāmo.

examples.text: dhamm'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno kath'āyaṃ nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā antaradhāyeyya vā, taṃ vā na sikkhitu'kāmo anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

62775.meaning2: having learnt, having trained oneself, having practised

62776.grammar: imp, reflx 2nd sg of sikkhatu, irreg form of sikkhassu, intrans (+loc)

examples.text: yato kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissasi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhissu sikkhāpadesu, tato tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi.
pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ, vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmi mahesi tuyhaṃ, tava sutvāna nigghosaṃ, sikkhe nibbānam'attano.
kodho mosavajjañ'ca kathaṃkathā ca, ete'pi dhammā dvayam'eva sante, kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe, ñatvā pavuttā samaṇena dhammā.

62778.meaning1: we could train; we should practise
62778.commentary: (NIDD1) sikkhemā'ti sikkhema ācarema samācarema samādāya vattemāti, idh'eva sikkhema.

examples.text: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.
kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ, paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, saṃcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
sā kho pana, bhante, bhaginī parakāminī hoti, sikhaṇḍī nāma mātalissa saṅgāhakassa putto, tam'abhikaṅkhati.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimattheyya, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti.
kusumitasikharā ca pādapā, abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā, kā tuyhaṃ rati bhavissati, yadi ekā vanam'ogahissasi.
uppalasikhar'opamāni te, vimale hāṭakasannibhe mukhe, tava me nayanāni dakkhiya, bhiyyo kāmaguṇo pavaḍḍhati.

62793.commentary: (DNa) jalam'aggisikhā'r'ivā'ti aggisikhā viya jalantā. jalam'aggi ca sikhā'r'ivā'ti imāni tesaṃ nāmānī'ti'pi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā, jalam'aggisikhā'r'iva, ariṭṭhakā ca rojā ca, umāpupphanibhāsino.

62796.commentary: (ANa) sikhāmoggallāno'ti sīsamajjhe ṭhitāya mahatiyā sikhāya samannāgato moggallānagotto brāhmaṇo.

examples.text: atha kho sikhāmoggallāno brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
